name: Aberrant Eidolon
text:
Your eidolon is a terrifying, incomprehensible nightmare patterned after the creatures who owe their existence to the Outer Gods and Great Old Ones. Aberrant eidolons come in a variety of forms, though their anatomies often appear twisted and impossible. Most people can't even look at any aberrant eidolon without developing a splitting headache or having a panic attack, but your studies of the occult have inured your mind to these dread terrors.

Tradition occult

Traits aberration, eidolon

Home Plane Dimension of Dreams or the Universe

---
Size Medium or Small

Suggested Attacks claw (slashing), jaws (piercing), tentacle (bludgeoning)

Eidolon Attributes Con +2, Int +1, Wis +1, Cha –1

Skills Athletics, Occultism

Senses darkvision

Language Aklo

Speed 25 feet

---
Initial (1st)—Surprising Anatomy R (eidolon)

Trigger An enemy adjacent to your eidolon deals damage to your eidolon

---
Effect Your eidolon's form shifts horribly to retaliate against the attacker. Your eidolon makes a melee unarmed Strike against the triggering enemy.

Symbiosis (7th)—Unfathomable Mind (mental, nonlethal) Those who try to touch your eidolon's mind find their own minds shattered. When your eidolon succeeds at a saving throw against a mental effect from a creature, that creature takes 4+max(0,(ceil((@actor.level -8/2))))d6 mental mental damage with a basic basic Will save save against your spell DC. A creature who fails this save is also Stupefied 1 (Stupefied 2 on a critical failure). At 9th level and every 2 levels thereafter, the damage increases by 1d6.

Transcendence (17th)—Maddening Whispers Your aberrant eidolon utters terrible secrets about the true nature of the universe. They can cast Unfathomable Song once per day as an innate occult spell. Your eidolon can Sustain this spell as a free action if they spend at least one action Striding toward one of the targets.
